$comment: Example price table (spec F6/F7, #12). Amounts are per million tokens, and per search or tool call, in the currency of the entry. 'as_of' is the date the operator checked the provider's price page: the values below are a starting point, not a statement of any provider's current prices; check each one before use and point PRICE_TABLE_FILE at your own copy. Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens unless 'reasoning_per_million' is set. Costs are shown in EUR: set EUR_PER_USD (EUR for 1 USD).
